Security at InfluencerMarketing.ai

Last updated: July 6, 2026

1. Our commitment

Security is foundational to InfluencerMarketing.ai. We maintain a written security program covering infrastructure, application development, vendor management and incident response.

2. Certifications & audits

Our controls are audited annually against SOC 2 Type II. We also undergo regular third-party penetration tests and continuous automated vulnerability scanning.

3. Data protection

  • Encryption in transit (TLS 1.2+) and at rest (AES-256).
  • Role-based access control and SSO/SAML for Enterprise plans.
  • Production access is limited, logged and reviewed; secrets are stored in a managed vault.
  • Daily encrypted backups with tested restore procedures.

4. Payments

Card payments are processed by PCI-DSS Level 1 payment providers. Full card numbers never touch our servers.

5. Reporting a vulnerability

We appreciate responsible disclosure. Report suspected vulnerabilities to hello@influencermarketing.ai and we will respond promptly.
